scripts.prepare: if [ -d .git ]; then if [ -f .git/hooks/pre-commit ] && [ ! -L .git/hooks/pre-commit ]; then BACKUP=".git/hooks/pre-commit.backup-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"; cp .git/hooks/pre-commit "$BACKUP"; echo "⚠️  Backed up custom pre-commit hook to $BACKUP" >&2; fi; ln -sf ../../scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit 2>/dev/null; fi || true
